drhp.business: Oswal Agro Mills Limited operates through trading, real estate and investment segments, dealing in trading of commodities and real estate assets, and earning income from interest on inter-corporate deposits (ICDs) and investments in mutual funds and equity instruments. The company also holds a real estate entitlement via Transferable Development Rights (TDR) received from the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) against land handed over at Village Anik, Chembur, Mumbai.
drhp.expansion: The company is exploring possibilities of undertaking real estate projects, and is in the process of transferring reserved land to BMC's name, after which it expects to receive the balance 50% of Development Rights Certificates (DRC) in its own name by March 2027. No named plant, capacity or asset-build project is otherwise disclosed.

litigation.note: Indian Bank raised a demand before the Debt Recovery Tribunal (DRT) along with a SARFAESI Act notice; DRT quashed the original application as premature, and the Bank's appeal is pending before the Debt Recovery Appellate Tribunal (DRAT). Separately, the associate (Oswal Greentech) has invoked arbitration over interest charged on an Inter-Corporate Deposit with a borrower.
